title: Congressional Democrats Launch Inquiry into Nvidia's Sales to China
summary: Democratic members of the U.S. House launched an investigation into Nvidia's hardware sales in China and foreign business arrangements. Lawmakers sent a formal inquiry demanding records following the executive leadership changes at the firm.
point1: U.S. House Democrats opened an investigation into Nvidia's international operations and China exports.
point2: The congressional inquiry could lead to increased regulatory oversight on advanced chip sales to foreign markets.

title: Six Killed in Israeli Air Strike on Gaza Hospital Complex
summary: An Israeli strike hit a building housing surgical and intensive care units at Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza. Health officials reported that six Palestinians were killed in the strike on the medical facility.
point1: A missile strike hit Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, resulting in six reported fatalities.
point2: Nasser Hospital is the main functioning healthcare facility serving southern Gaza.

title: Ukrainian Drone Hits Russian Warship in Gulf of Finland
summary: A Ukrainian uncrewed aerial vehicle struck a Russian naval vessel operating in the Gulf of Finland. The operation marks the first reported Ukrainian strike against a Russian warship in the Baltic Sea.
point1: A Russian warship sustained a strike by a Ukrainian drone in the Gulf of Finland.
point2: The engagement demonstrates an expansion of Ukraine's maritime strike distance into open waters of the Baltic region.

title: Kia and Suppliers Plan $2 Billion Investment for Second Manufacturing Plant in Andhra Pradesh
summary: Kia and its supplier ecosystem signed a memorandum of understanding with the Andhra Pradesh government to invest $2 billion in establishing a second manufacturing facility in the state. The expansion project is expected to create 12,000 direct and indirect jobs.
point1: Kia and associated suppliers announced a $2 billion investment agreement with Andhra Pradesh.
point2: The deal aims to generate approximately 12,000 jobs and expand automotive production capacity in India.
point3: Production at the new facility is scheduled to start by 2030.

title: India Retail Inflation Rises to 6.1% in October, Breaching RBI Limit
summary: India's Consumer Price Index retail inflation rose to 6.1% in October 2026, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance threshold of 6% for the first time in two years. Price increases were recorded across nearly all major consumer spending categories.
point1: Retail inflation hit 6.1% in October 2026, breaching the RBI's 6% maximum target limit.
point2: Broadening inflationary pressures across multiple categories could influence upcoming central bank monetary policy decisions.

title: US Envoys Meet Zelensky in Dublin Following Moscow Talks with Putin
summary: United States envoys held discussions with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in Dublin after completing talks in Moscow with Russian President Vladimir Putin. US envoy Steve Witkoff stated Putin agreed to allow European negotiators to participate in the next round of peace talks.
point1: US diplomatic envoys met President Zelensky in Dublin immediately after negotiations with President Putin in Moscow.
point2: Russia reportedly agreed to include European nations in upcoming diplomatic negotiations regarding Ukraine.

title: Major Microsoft Outlook Outage Disrupts Business Email Globally
summary: Microsoft's Outlook email service suffered a major outage affecting enterprise and commercial users. The company reported that its systems were experiencing elevated loads while technical teams worked to address the issue.
point1: An outage impacted Microsoft Outlook email and Microsoft 365 services for business users across multiple regions.
point2: The service interruption blocked corporate customers from sending and receiving routine email communications.

title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO Amid Investigation into Alleged Security Affair
summary: Nvidia co-founder and Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang has resigned following an internal investigation into his relationship with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset. Longtime Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress has been appointed interim CEO to lead the company.
point1: Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO after an internal probe into an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
point2: Nvidia is the primary provider of AI hardware globally, making its executive leadership change highly consequential for the technology market.
point3: Colette Kress has assumed the role of interim CEO while the board conducts a leadership transition.

title: Qualcomm cuts over 1,000 jobs in India amid global restructuring
summary: Semiconductor designer Qualcomm is cutting more than 1,000 positions across its India operations as part of global workforce reductions. Chief Executive Officer Cristiano Amon framed the decision as a performance-focused cost-cutting measures.
point1: Over 1,000 Qualcomm employees in India face job cuts.
point2: The reductions are part of a worldwide performance and restructuring initiative across the chipmaker's global footprint.

title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved to military base following Iranian threats
summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has been relocated to reside on a military base following credible threat intelligence linked to Iran. Bessent is one of multiple administration officials moved to high-security military housing due to safety concerns.
point1: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was moved to housing on a military installation.
point2: The relocation follows specific security threats attributed to Iranian sources against U.S. cabinet officials.

title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat in historic election
summary: Democrat Scott Colom secured victory in the U.S. Senate election in Mississippi. The outcome makes Colom the first Black individual to represent Mississippi in the United States Senate in over 140 years.
point1: Scott Colom won the Mississippi U.S. Senate election.
point2: He becomes the first Black senator elected from Mississippi since the Reconstruction era over 140 years ago.

title: Indonesia's vice president resigns as ruling political alliance frays
summary: Indonesia's vice president has resigned from office following growing political friction within the governing coalition. The departure underscores escalating division between President Prabowo Subianto and former President Joko Widodo.
point1: The Indonesian vice president tendered his resignation from government.
point2: The exit reflects a deepening political rift between President Prabowo and his predecessor's political faction.

title: UK AI chip startup Fractile raises $720M in new funding round
summary: British semiconductor startup Fractile secured $720 million in its latest funding round to advance the development of specialized AI hardware. The capital injection makes Fractile one of the most heavily funded independent players competing in the purpose-built AI chip sector.
point1: Fractile raised $720 million to expand its AI chip development operations.
point2: The funding establishes the UK firm among the top-capitalized ventures seeking to build alternative hardware for artificial intelligence processing.

title: Congress calls Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang for briefing on alleged Chinese spy affair
summary: House Republicans have summoned Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to appear for a closed-door briefing regarding his reported affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence agent. Huang was given until the end of Wednesday to respond to the congressional request.
point1: House Republicans called for a closed-door briefing with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding national security concerns.
point2: The inquiry centers on allegations involving an affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence agent during a crucial period of U.S.-China AI infrastructure competition.
point3: Huang was given until the end of Wednesday to respond to the request.

title: Navi Mumbai recognised as India’s cleanest city by Central Government
summary: Navi Mumbai has been named India's cleanest city in the Central Government's Swachh Survekshan annual sanitation rankings, surpassing Indore which held the position for eight straight years. Surat and Vijayawada secured second and third place respectively.
point1: Navi Mumbai secured top rank in the national urban cleanliness assessment.
point2: Indore lost its top spot after holding the ranking for eight consecutive years.
point3: Awards were formally declared at the national government ceremony.

title: Moody’s ups India’s FY27 growth estimate to 7% on broad-based momentum
summary: Global rating agency Moody's has upgraded India's real GDP growth estimate for FY2027 to 7%, up from previous projections. The agency attributed the upward revision to strong domestic consumption, robust macroeconomic indicators, and accelerating investment momentum.
point1: Moody's raised its forecast for India's FY27 economic growth to 7.0%.
point2: Resilient consumer spending and expanding capital expenditure support sustained growth.
point3: Moody's expects India to maintain near 7% GDP growth over the medium term.

title: Duolingo, Strava, and Ticketmaster Are All Caught Up in EU’s New Digital Fairness Rules
summary: The European Union's upcoming Digital Fairness Act targets dark patterns, addictive application design, and undisclosed paid influencer promotions. Major online platforms such as Duolingo, Strava, and Ticketmaster will be required to alter specific consumer engagement and monetization mechanics.
point1: EU regulations target interface tricks, covert influencer advertising, and forced online engagement.
point2: Popular consumer software products must redesign user interaction features in Europe.
point3: Implementation schedules are being established across European Union member states.

title: A New AI Tool From Google DeepMind Proved the Signal Protocol Is Secure
summary: Researchers at Google DeepMind used an advanced AI system to mathematically verify the underlying Signal end-to-end encryption protocol. DeepMind stated that its long-term ambition is to use formal automated AI verification across global software systems.
point1: Google DeepMind formally verified the mathematical integrity of the Signal encryption protocol.
point2: Automated code verification could prevent widespread cyber vulnerabilities in essential software.
point3: DeepMind aims to apply automated formal verification to additional complex software suites.

title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
summary: Health officials in Kenya have discharged the country's final recovering Ebola patient from medical care. The discharge marks the start of a mandatory 42-day countdown required before the nation can be officially certified as Ebola-free.
point1: Kenya successfully discharged its final admitted Ebola patient.
point2: Reaching Ebola-free status represents a critical public health achievement for East Africa.
point3: A mandatory 42-day surveillance countdown has begun before official virus-free declaration.

title: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
summary: Spain experienced significant public disruption as workers launched the country's first nationwide general strike in 14 years. Demonstrations broke out across major cities less than three weeks before upcoming parliamentary elections.
point1: The action marks Spain's first general strike in 14 years.
point2: The political impact is amplified by upcoming parliamentary elections in less than three weeks.
point3: Protests are scheduled to continue in major Spanish metropolitan areas.

title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
summary: Peace discussions between Russia and Ukraine held in Abu Dhabi focused on Europe's future security framework but concluded without a breakthrough. U.S. envoys are scheduled to meet directly with President Vladimir Putin and President Volodymyr Zelensky on Thursday.
point1: Negotiations in Abu Dhabi centered on defining Europe's post-war security architecture.
point2: The diplomatic initiative reflects high-level international efforts to resolve the ongoing war.
point3: U.S. envoys are scheduled to meet with Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

title: India Prohibits Unsorted Lithium-Ion Battery Scrap and Waste Exports
summary: The Indian government has amended its trade regulations to ban the export of unsorted lithium-ion battery waste and scrap under the 'Free' category. The policy adjustment seeks to preserve critical raw materials within India's domestic processing and recycling ecosystem.
point1: The export of unsorted lithium-ion battery scrap under the 'Free' trade category has been officially prohibited.
point2: The policy change is intended to retain critical battery raw materials for domestic processing.

title: Indian Stock Markets Reach Eight-Month Highs Driven by Returning Foreign Capital
summary: Benchmark Indian stock indices Sensex and Nifty 50 reached eight-month highs during trading on Wednesday. The rally comes as foreign institutional investors resume net purchases in the domestic market following months of capital outflows.
point1: The Sensex and Nifty 50 indices rose over 10% in November, reaching eight-month high levels.
point2: The surge was driven by renewed buying activity and capital inflows from foreign portfolio investors.

title: Air India Flight Isolated in Kolkata Following Airborne Hijack Threat Note
summary: An Air India flight operating from Kolkata to Mumbai was grounded and directed to an isolation bay after a hijack threat note was found on board. Security personnel deboarded all passengers at Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport to execute safety sweeps.
point1: A note threatening a hijack was discovered aboard a Kolkata-Mumbai Air India flight.
point2: The aircraft was moved to an isolation bay and all passengers were deboarded for security screening.
point3: Security personnel and aviation agencies are conducting full inspection protocols on the plane.

title: US House of Representatives Blocks Impeachment Motion Against Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
summary: The U.S. House of Representatives voted to block an impeachment effort brought against Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth. President Donald Trump publicly supported Hegseth following the procedural vote.
point1: The U.S. House of Representatives voted to block a motion seeking to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth.
point2: President Donald Trump welcomed the vote outcome praising the cabinet official.
point3: House Democrats may reattempt impeachment proceedings in the next legislative session.

title: US Department of Justice Details Iran-Backed Plot Targeting RAF Fairford Airbase
summary: The U.S. Department of Justice announced that three Iran-backed suspects planned multiple attack plots, including an incident near RAF Fairford in the United Kingdom. The military installation is regularly utilized by U.S. armed forces.
point1: Three Iran-backed suspects were identified by the US Department of Justice in connection with attack plots.
point2: The targeted locations included an incident near RAF Fairford, a UK airbase used by US forces.

title: Senior US Army Soldier Arrested in London on Suspicion of Spying for Russia
summary: A 41-year-old senior United States Army soldier has been arrested in London by British law enforcement officials. The soldier is accused of committing national security offenses related to alleged espionage for Russia.
point1: A 41-year-old senior US Army soldier was taken into custody in London.
point2: The arrest was made on suspicion of national security offences and espionage for Russia.
point3: The suspect is currently undergoing questioning by authorities in London.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Faces Scrutiny Over Extramarital Affair With Alleged Chinese Spy
summary: Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang is facing severe national security and corporate scrutiny following revelations of an extramarital relationship with an alleged Chinese intelligence operative. The scandal comes amidst heightened US-China competition over AI supply chains and technology hardware.
point1: Jensen Huang was linked to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
point2: The revelations raise national security concerns over critical US AI infrastructure and leadership.
